title: 每日 X 精华引用榜

items.reason: 用经典「sudo make me a sandwich」一句话把 DoorDash CLI 变成技术圈迷因级锐评
items.reasonEn: One-liner reframes DoorDash’s agent CLI as the classic sudo-make-me-a-sandwich joke — commentary that owns the chain

items.reason: 把 Inkling 发布重构成「唯一未蒸馏自 OpenAI/Anthropic 的开放权重前沿模型」，观点盖过原帖叙事
items.reasonEn: Reframes Inkling as the rare open-weight frontier stack not distilled from OpenAI/Anthropic — the claim that defined the thread

items.reason: 在他人参数盘点之上补上 conv/RMSNorm/相对位置偏置等架构要点，专家拆解胜过官宣
items.reasonEn: Expert architecture add-on (conv layers, embedding RMSNorm, relative bias vs RoPE) that out-explains the release posts

items.reason: 用 GPT-5.6 Sol Pro 证伪 BH 程序在相关高斯检验上的 FDR 猜想，给科研推文官方背书
items.reasonEn: Amplifies a Wharton result: GPT-5.6 Sol Pro disproved a long-open BH/FDR conjecture — research that needed the quote spotlight

items.reason: 用「Open Source/open weights… what OpenAI was supposed to be」把 Inkling 开源直接刺向 OpenAI 初心
items.reasonEn: Sharp dunk: open weights as “what OpenAI was supposed to be,” reframing Thinking Machines’ drop as an industry rebuke

items.reason: 在 Linus 力挺内核用 AI 的截图上表态：软件开发已不可逆地变天
items.reasonEn: Ladybird founder backs Linus on AI in the kernel and frames it as irreversible industry change

items.reason: 把 Elon 太空 AI 卫星功耗上调翻译成 NVL72/Rubin 机架可部署的具体规格
items.reasonEn: Translates Musk’s AI1 satellite power hike into clear NVL72/Rubin rack capacity for a general tech audience

items.reason: 中文圈第一时间把 Inkling 标成 Llama 之后美国真正可用的完全开放权重大模型
items.reasonEn: Chinese-tech framing of Inkling as the first fully open-weight U.S. model worth playing with post-Llama

items.reason: 点破马斯克开源 Grok Build 是为解决信任问题，并补上 Rust/仓库链接
items.reasonEn: Chinese-dev take: open-sourcing Grok Build is the right trust move (plus Rust + repo context)

items.reason: 对续费焦虑帖直接给出「用 Codex + 开源仓自写指纹浏览器」的反杀级方案，互动远超原推
items.reasonEn: Outperforms a low-engagement renewal-whine by shipping a Codex-from-OSS fingerprint-browser alternative

items.reason: 把 AI 产业链「缺货」叙事从 GPU/存储/光电扭到「信用担保才是最硬缺货」
items.reasonEn: Ex-GS finance take: AI scarcity trade is credit/guarantee supply, not just chips, power, or optics

items.reason: 引用自家周期图回击「比特币已死」，把 12–18 个月熊市与减半后修正框架重新钉上时间线
items.reasonEn: Cycle chart quote that reframes “Bitcoin is dead” as a standard post-halving 12-month correction window
